entries.source: Geschichte der Grafen von Wertheim von den ältesten bis zu ihrem Erlöschen im Mannsstamme im Jahre 1556, Nr. LV. , S. 84, LV.
entries.german:
Graf Rudolf von Wertheim verkauft dem Kloster Brombach Güter in Wenkheim und Nassig. 1300. Mai 31.

Nos Rudolfus comes de Wertheim et coUateralis nostra do- inhta Kuneyuudis. Universis presentium tenorem inspecturis no- Inni esse cupimus publice profitendo, quod nos coadunata manu vendidimus et tradidimus, vendimus et tradimus per presen- tes dom. Abbati et conventui in Brunnebach bona nostra in Weginkeim sita, videl. molendinum inferius, solvens annuatim Till maltera siliginis, et I. lib. hall. Item bona que colit Henricus det Hoveman, annuatim solv. IV. malt. siliginis et Vmalt. avene. Item bona que colunt Godfridus filius advocati et Godfridus filius dieti Ailbern, annuatim solv. I. malt. tritici et XV solid. hall. et II denarios. Item bona que colit det. Hclleman annuatim solv. X summera siliginis et X summera avene. Item bona que colunt filii quondam dicti Helzinberger et filii quondam dicti Graggeis, annuatim solv. I. malt. silig. et I malt. avene. Item bona que colunt Jutta molendinaria et lii-nrirus Filius suus annuatim solv. 1 malt. tritici et XV solid. et IV hall. Item bona que colit Gerungus annuatim solv. 1 malt. silig. et X sol. hall. et dimidiam curiam nos- tram in Nassach sitam; annuatim solv. VIII malt. silig. cum area sibi conjuneta solv. annuatim solid. XII. pro centum dfcem et octo libr. et IX solidis et II hall. cum omnibus eorundem bonorum pertinentiis eultis et incultis, quesitis et inquirendis, mero proprietatis jure perpetuo possidenda, nihil nobis omnino juris super predictis bonis reservantes preter homines nostros utriusque sexus, de quibus solummodo exae- tiones requirere poterimus, non tamen in predictorum abbatis et conventus prejudicium libertatis, qui nihilominus predicti coloni vel eorum successores gaudeant ea libertate in pratis, paseuis, in silvis et in omnibus, qua hactenus sunt gavisi; quam prediclam summam peeunie proütemur ab ipsis ex inte- gro reeepisse atque im proprios usus convertisse, cum etiam predictorum bonorum aliqua in domorum edifieiis sunt destrueta prefatis abbati et conventui hanc contulimus et conferimus per presentes libertatem, videl. ut predict. bonorum colonos, si in solutione censuum et proventuum negligentes extiterint, pro suis negligentiis in ecclesia, cemiterio, in strata, in cflmpo et circumquaque in terminis nostri judicii impignorare poterunt sine Vara. Ad pred. bonorum autem warandiam sepedictis abbati et conventui faciendam secundum jus pro- prietatis debitam et consuetam fideijussores: Fridericum de Vlache, Arnoldum Bleiche, Eberhardum filium Conradi militis de Ussenkeim, Conradum Clinhard militis in solid um obliga- mus, (die etwa nöthige Substituirung der fideiussores wird versprochen in fast gleicher Weise, wie in der Urkunde v. J. i30i~). Ut autem omnia supradicta rata permaneant et inconvulsa presentem exinde conscriptam cum appensione sigilli nostri et sigilli conjugis nostre prcf. dedimus literam roboratam. Dat. et act. an. dom. MCCC. dominica infra octa- vam ascensionis domini.
entries.english: Count Rudolf von Wertheim and his wife Kunigund sell and convey to the abbot and convent of Brombach their properties at Wenkheim—including the lower mill and various tenant holdings—and half their court at Nassig, with all appurtenances, cultivated and uncultivated. They reserve only their men and the right to exact dues from them, while the tenants retain their customary liberties. The buyers may pledge negligent tenants for unpaid rents and dues within Rudolf's jurisdiction. Rudolf and Kunigund acknowledge receipt of the purchase price and provide sureties, including Eberhard, son of Konrad the knight von Ussenkeim. Given on the Sunday within the octave of the Ascension in 1300.
